image_description: A close-up photograph of a green snake, identified as a green mamba, coiled on a piece of light-colored driftwood. The snake's head is facing the camera, showing large dark eyes and smooth scales. The body curves behind the head, displaying uniform emerald green coloration.

The snout appears oddly flattened and symmetrical in a way that defies typical perspective foreshortening, contributing to the incorrect 'blunt' head shape noted in checkpoints.
